summaries.found_via_query: When was Findus divested and which brand did Nestlé acquire in the same year?
summaries.summary: This slide from Nestlé's 2011 Full Year Results Roadshow shows divestitures between 2000 and 2011, with sales totaling ~17 billion CHF. It highlights key divestitures including Findus EUR (divested in 2000), and lists acquisitions such as Minag Water GER, Dallmayr &G, Trinks GER, and others. The slide also shows that in 2000, Nestlé divested Findus EUR and acquired Frozen Potato USA, and in 2001, it acquired Eugene Perma EUR (cosmetics).
key_facts: In 2000, Nestlé acquired Frozen Potato USA.
Eugene Perma EUR (cosmetics) was acquired in 2001.
Divestitures occurred between 2000 and 2011 with total sales of ~17 billion CHF.
The slide is from Nestlé's 2011 Full Year Results Roadshow on February 21st, 2012.
visible_text: Significant divestitures rationalized the portfolio and eliminated non strategic and loss-making businesses
Divestitures 2000 to 2011: Sales in CHF ~17 bn
